transcript.text: Good morning, everyone. Let's get started on the waste-disposition huddle. We've got eighteen totes of spent solvent from the cleaning process staged in the waste area awaiting disposition. I understand the environmental compliance specialist and logistics coordinator have findings to report before I sign off on the shipment plan. Who'd like to go first?
transcript.speaker: A1

transcript.text: I need to flag something important before we proceed. My laboratory review this morning reclassified the spent solvent as UN1993 flammable liquid, packing group II — it's not routine recyclable solvent. This means the 18 totes must be transferred into 18 UN-rated steel drums before shipment, and a hazardous-waste manifest is required. I haven't entered the classification into the formal waste register yet because I've been waiting for the plant manager's disposition signature.
transcript.speaker: A2

transcript.text: I have an update on the carrier side. I confirmed with the licensed hazardous-waste carrier that it will accept these 18 drums only for a Friday 16:00 pickup, provided they are arranged on exactly 3 pallets and the manifest is submitted by 12:00 Friday. I haven't booked the pickup yet because the waste classification was awaiting confirmation — which Jonas has now provided.
transcript.speaker: A3
